name: STORM LOVER 2nd
source:
A sequel to Storm Lover/Storm Lover Kai!, featuring a new heroine and a new set of guys, with the exception of Nanao Shiina from the previous games. Our heroine Arashiyama Mari, has just moved to town and starts her 2nd year of high school at St. Louis High.

[Edited from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2013/07/13/otome-game-review-storm-lover-2nd/]Hinano's post[/url]]
